I've run into this bug quite a few times, and it is frustrating to have to attach and detach Hmisc whenever I run into it in my documents. 

One simple (and perhaps obvious) workaround is to use summariSe in ddply so it doesn't interfere with summariZe in Hmisc. 

For the record, this is the first time that I've been thankful for the peculiarities in UK/US spelling differences. 

On Friday, February 5, 2010 2:44:03 PM UTC-5, Dennis Murphy wrote:
Uh, yuh. Ahhhhhhhhhhhhh.....it's ahead of plyr in the search list, so its
summarize() masks your summarize(). OMG...no one's fault, but I've had
a frustrating morning with ddply and summarize. Lesson learned; I'll
know to check next time.....Thanks!

Dennis
